settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Each painting is rolled into an archival tube or flat-packed in foam-lined crating depending on size. All shipments are fully insured and tracked.

Preparation 4-6 weeks. India delivery 3-5 days after dispatch. International 7-14 days after dispatch. All sales final; commissions non-refundable.

settings.heading: Certificate of Authenticity
settings.content:
Every original work ships with a hand-signed physical certificate, embossed with the studio seal, catalogued with a unique registration number. A digital PDF version is emailed for insurance and resale purposes.

The certificate documents title, year, medium, dimensions, edition status, and provenance history.
